tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and chart axis labels on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, source lines, speaker-note hints, chart tick labels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, table borders, chart gridlines. Never text.

tokens.name: tank-orange
tokens.usage: T-200 orange fluid. Also the carryover / old-recipe residue colour in diagrams and charts. Passes 4.5:1 as text on surface-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: tank-blue
tokens.usage: T-400 blue fluid. Also OUR METHOD series in every chart and the main accent for headings marks and links.

tokens.name: tank-clear
tokens.usage: T-100 clear fluid (diluent). Fill only, never text. Use for clean vials and the new-recipe part of a vial diagram.

tokens.name: baseline
tokens.usage: Every baseline series in charts (first-vial rule, vision-only check, drainage-only model). Grey so our method reads first.

tokens.name: flag
tokens.usage: A flagged vial, a miss, or a failure case. Use small: a dot, a tag, one number. Always pair with a word, not colour alone.

tokens.name: placeholder-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a TODO placeholder box in the scaffold deck. Delete with the placeholder.

tokens.name: placeholder-ink
tokens.usage: Text and dashed border of a TODO placeholder box, on placeholder-bg.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Title slide and section dividers only.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: One per slide. Say the point of the slide, not the topic.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Column or card headings inside a slide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The first vial after a recipe change holds residue from the old recipe.
styles.usage: Slide body text. Max about 25 words per block. Sizes are for the 1920 x 1080 slide canvas; never under 24px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Source lines under every number and chart, in ink-muted.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: One big measured number per slide, with its count and source below.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Evidence tags, tank names, vial IDs, axis titles.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a number and its caption; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a list or between chart and source line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between columns and cards on a slide.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Slide outer margin on the 1920 x 1080 canvas.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Evidence tags, chart bars (top corners only).

tokens.name: radius-vial
tokens.usage: Vial shapes in diagrams and the cover: a pill whose radius is half its width.
